metadata.model: 10 m ground elevations sampled beneath FOT railway geometry; reduced terrain mesh; no surveyed track height, tunnels or cable profile

railSource.model: scheduled interpolation; FOT rail and cableway alignments; cartographic water-constrained boat paths
railSource.note: Lake Lucerne boats, Rigi cogwheel railways and Weggis–Rigi Kaltbad cableway. Boat paths are modelled, not shipping lanes. The map is 2D; vertical cable and terrain profiles remain separate work.

water.method: shortest paths constrained to the cartographic lake polygon; not observed routes or shipping lanes

metadata.routeSource: Federal Office of Transport rail network

sourceEvidence.elevationMeaning: ground beneath alignment, not track survey
sourceEvidence.lakeSurfaceModel: median terrain sample within clipped cartographic lake
